items.close: Close a dialog, menu or panel
items.toggleAll: Open or close all toggles and groups on the page
items.saveVersion: Save a version of the page
items.mention: Mention a person, page or date
items.copyBlockLink: Copy a link to the block
items.dictate: Dictate at the cursor (press again or Enter to finish, or hold while you talk)
items.openRow: Open the focused row or card
items.previousRow: Previous row (with a row open beside the view)
items.nextRow: Next row (with a row open beside the view)
items.moveBar: Move a timeline bar by a day
items.saveFormula: Save a formula or an AI autofill prompt
items.fillDown: Fill the selected table cells down from the top ones (with one row’s cells selected, duplicate it)
items.rowDuplicate: Duplicate the row (its menu open in a table)
items.rowMoveTo: Move the row elsewhere (its menu open)
items.rowComment: Comment on the row (its menu open)
items.rowTrash: Move the row to the trash (its menu open)
items.newSubPage: Make a page inside this one, linked in the text (after a space)
items.mailBack: Back to the list, or leave the selection
items.mailSelectAll: Select every conversation in the list
items.mailArchive: Archive, or move back to the inbox
items.mailTrash: Move to the trash (delete forever there)
